name: chaos

findings.title: calibration_finish reported 'done' while model/ was read-only (save likely silently failed)
findings.detail: Daemon.finishCalibration logs a Log.error on saveModel failure but always broadcasts phase:done regardless of whether the save succeeded.

metrics.restore_sensors_stdout: nothing to restore: no sensor settings were left behind

notes: SIGKILL-mid-config_set: 15/15 trials left config.json (+.bak) valid JSON (ConfigStore.write()'s atomic Data.write held up)
SIGKILL-mid-model-save: 10/10 trials left model/report/samples files valid JSON
--restore-sensors after SIGKILL: exit 0, printed 'nothing to restore: no sensor settings were left behind'
fresh daemon started cleanly against the same --config-dir right after --restore-sensors
recovered after restoring permissions: config_set succeeded (config)

clock-jump chaos test skipped: changing the system clock needs sudo (prohibited by the overnight safety rules), and the daemon's CLI has no --simulate-clock-jump hook to fault-inject this in-process; out of reach for a black-box, no-sudo stress test.
